subject: Dedicated capacity proposal and commit options: BluePeak Analytics
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity proposal and commit options: BluePeak Analytics

Sarah — good to follow up after our call. Below is a concise sizing + commercial proposal based on the workload profile you shared (summary at top, more detail in attached CSV). I tried to balance unit-costs with headroom for bursts.

Workload summary (your inputs):
- Peak requests: ~1,800 requests / 10-minute window (~3 req/sec sustained during peaks)
- Typical concurrency observed: 20-30 concurrent active requests
- Avg prompt context: ~1,024 tokens; avg generation: ~256 tokens
- SLAs desired: 95th pct latency target under 800ms for 1k context; uptime SLA desired 99.95%

Redwood recommendation (Dedicated):
- Baseline pool: 3x H100 (80GB) inference machines sized for low-latency, high-concurrency production.
- Burst option: 1x additional H100 reserved as burst capacity (autoscale/burst credits) for traffic spikes.
- Performance notes: With our kernel selection and KV prefix caching we expect your 95th pct generation latency to stay under target for the stated profile at the baseline + burst configuration. Batching + request shaping will further reduce per-token cost.

Commercial (starting point):
- 12-month reserved commit for baseline pool (3 GPUs): $38,000 / month (USD)
- Burst GPU (standby capacity): $7,500 / month (USD) — billed pro rata when used; included burst budget on monthly statement.
- Discount: standard 12-mo commit includes 12% discount off list; we can discuss deeper concessions depending on term/commit level.
- SLA: 99.95% uptime; optional 99.99% for +$2,500/mo
- Onboarding credit: 10% of first 3 months usage as a one-time credit to help offset migration/testing.

Open items we need from you:
- Confirmation of expected QPS profile (sustained vs burst) so we can tighten sizing to your traffic curve.
- Decision on term length (12 vs 24 months) — longer terms allow us to improve the price.

Next steps: if this aligns, I can circulate a formal quote and DocuSign with the sizing annex and a mutual action plan (kickoff, two-week ramp, production switch). Want to schedule a quick 30-min session with Karthik (SE) to validate the latency numbers and check caching strategy?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

From: Sarah Park <sarah@bluepeak.ai>

Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal and commit options: BluePeak Analytics

Marcus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few quick questions/asks from procurement and engineering: 

1) Pricing: the baseline + burst at listed price is higher than other proposals we’re evaluating. Can you do better on the 12-mo price? If not, what pricing for a 24-mo commit looks like (we prefer lower monthly cost).

2) Throughput SLA: we need a firmer guarantee for peak sustained throughput (we can commit to a predictable schedule). Can Redwood provide a guaranteed throughput number (e.g., X requests / sec at 95th pct latency) with credit-backed remedies if missed?

3) Headroom / burst: How quickly does Redwood bring the burst GPU online and how much billing is pro-rated vs fully charged? We expect unpredictable spikes tied to batch reprocessing.

4) Can you confirm the feasibility of reducing the baseline to 2 GPUs if we accept slightly higher latency for heavy tails? That would materially change economics for us.

We’re targeting procurement sign-off by next week if pricing and SLAs can be agreed. Happy to jump on a call with Karthik to validate technical things.

— Sarah
Sarah Park
Head of Platform Engineering | BluePeak Analytics
sarah@bluepeak.ai

- Do we have flexibility to move to a 24-mo at meaningful discount without CP approval? Lauren, what’s our standard enterprise concession band?

Thanks — Marcus
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BluePeak pricing and throughput asks (internal)

Quick technical readout based on the workload CSV and our perf bench: 
- The 95th pct latency target under 1k context is the sensitive constraint. 2x H100 baseline will likely hit capacity for sustained peak windows and push 95th pct above 800ms on heavy tails unless we limit concurrency or accept lower quality (shorter generations).
- Practical recommendation: 2x H100 can work if BluePeak agrees to:
  * strict concurrency cap (max 12 concurrent requests) OR
  * offload some large-context requests to a queued batch path (not user-facing), and
  * enable aggressive KV prefix caching for repeated prompt families.
- Safe prod recommendation: 3x H100 baseline + 1x H100 burst. This gives margin for autoscaling, graceful degradation, and preserves latency SLO for the interactive surface.

About guaranteed throughput and credits: we can publish a throughput commitment (requests/sec at 1k context) tied to the provisioned pool. For credit-backed remedies we usually:
- Offer service credits up to 5% of monthly fee for breaches of the throughput SLA (per quarter, escalated review).
- For stricter credit bands (10%+), legal/finance needs to sign off; that usually aligns with larger commitments or a higher subscription price.

Operational notes on burst: Handoff to burst GPUs is near-immediate within our orchestration (typical <60s); we bill burst pro rata by the minute when burst capacity is consumed. We can carve a small monthly burst budget (e.g., 120 minutes) included at no additional charge for the first quarter to aid ramp.

Happy to join a calibrating call with BluePeak to walk through these trade-offs; I can bring example latency curves for 2x vs 3x.

— Karthik (SE)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@bluepeak.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom@bluepeak.ai>, procurement@bluepeak.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal and commit options: BluePeak Analytics — updated commercial

Sarah / Tom — thanks for the feedback. We aligned internally and below is an updated offer that tries to meet your procurement timeline while addressing throughput guarantees.

Updated commercial offer (best and final for initial procurement window):
- Baseline: 3x H100 (80GB) + Burst: 1x H100 on standby.
- Price (12-month term): $34,500 / month (USD) for baseline (11% reduction vs prior). Burst: $6,800 / month pro-rated for usage.
- Alternate: 24-month term at $30,000 / month (USD) baseline (15% reduction vs prior) — requires 24-mo signed commit.
- SLA: Throughput guarantee — 3x baseline + burst provides guaranteed 180 requests / minute at 95th pct latency <= 900ms (1k context). Failure to meet this specific throughput SLA triggers service credits up to 5% of monthly fee (applied after joint operational review). Stricter credit tiers can be structured for higher commit levels.
- Burst behavior: burst pool stood up typically <60s; billing is per-minute for burst usage. We will include 180 minutes/month burst credit for the first 2 months free to smooth ramp.
- Onboarding credit: 15% of the first month's invoice applied as one-time credit (applies to 12-mo offer).

Attached is a formal quote and a DocuSign envelope (BP-2026-0421-commit.docx). Proposed mutual action plan:
- Confirm commercial term by Thu 09 Jul 2026
- Legal review week of 12 Jul 2026 (we can engage Redwood Legal for accelerated redlines)
- Technical kickoff: 14 Jul 2026 (SE-led)
- Production switch: target 28 Jul 2026 (two-week ramp)

Please let me know if this addresses procurement and engineering constraints. Happy to hop on a call with Karthik tomorrow to walk the latency curves and cadence.

Thanks — Marcus
